post.author: SF-UberMan
post.title: How do I make the games that I play feel more replayable?
post.body: I am right now playing Kingdom Rush, and when playing I realised something about many non-live service games: They aren't exactly faring well in the replayability department. Like, sure, there is some novelty trying it out the first time, but after some time there just isn't much fun due to decreased replayability, especially if said games require sticking to a fixed playstyle or are relatively predictable. This includes games like Kingdom Rush, Super Mario Galaxy, Wario Land: Shake It, Donkey Kong Country Returns and more. How do I scratch that replayability itch of mine?
